svg.title: Independent dataset rows versus dependent sequence timesteps
svg.desc: Dataset rows for an ANN are independent of each other and can be grouped into any batch size, whether one row, thirty two rows, or all five hundred at once. Sequence timesteps for an RNN are dependent in a fixed order, since each hidden state requires the previous one, so they cannot be reordered or grouped arbitrarily.
svg.text: can't reorder, can't batch within one sequence
only real choice: how many DIFFERENT sequences
to run in parallel, and where to cut for gradients
